desc: Derive and verify the one-dimensional transformed cut-point DP identity from the partition cost.

Implement the one-dimensional transformed cut-point DP using prefix sums P and C: dp[0]=0, dp[v] = min_{u<v} dp[u] + k*C[n] - C[u]*(P[v]-P[u]+k), and return P[n]*C[n] + dp[n]; verify it on the provided examples plus tiny random brute-force partition cases.
Finalize the solution code with the required starter class, type hints, and delimiters.
